judgment_checks.criterion: Both updates use old states; beta-first imperative code is equivalent. Using new Theta changes method.
Convergence target is sample 2SLS. Distance to beta_true alone does not test H1.
Rank, actual step scaling and spectral diagnostic checked on actual data; no transplant of author numeric thresholds to new seeds.

Finite transient, nonmonotonicity, finite precision and repeated-rate polynomial factors may matter. Do not require exact equality to Lambda^t or assume every stable-looking trace establishes asymptotic big-O.
Evidence must distinguish one-dataset optimization behavior from repeated-sample generality. Paired comparisons or equivalently justified designs accepted; no mandatory author grid.
Faithful informative counterexamples, failures or qualified negative findings can earn high quality. No need to match the author's conclusion.
No extrapolation to trained Transformer efficacy or universal theorem from finite numerical outcomes.

scope: Section 3.2 / Appendix C.2 numerical coupled-gradient analysis only; no Transformer training claim

Scope does not establish a mathematically universal exponential-rate claim; adverse evidence must not be penalized for contradicting source rhetoric.
